base_protocol.arrival_model: independent Poisson arrivals per second; common tape across budgets
base_protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames; released jobs only; FIFO within class
base_protocol.score: queue weighted actual frame departures divided by actual frame duration
base_protocol.budget_unit: candidate construction or feasibility attempt; seeds included
base_protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at horizon, then drain the same finite prefix

protocol.role: development only, original seeds 41/42/43; no confirmation seeds
protocol.gate_derivation: b_i=max_a D_ai; w_i=lcm(b)/b_i; C=lanes*max_a(w dot D_a)
protocol.activation: strict w dot Q > C, from visible queues before candidate generation, including drain
protocol.gate_interpretation: every feasible frame has w dot D<=C, so activation implies some visible work must remain; the converse need not hold
protocol.branches: active: frozen lookahead with terminal weight 1 and 1% cap; inactive: frozen v4
protocol.support: both branches retain the seed lower bound; active loss<=1% of paid support incumbent, inactive loss=0
protocol.accounting: exactly one search per frame; gate setup reads counted once per run, one weighted queue scan per frame; prediction work only on active frames
protocol.arrival_rate_input: same registered per-class rates throughout arrival window and drain
protocol.reference: v4 at K120; K120 of a cost selector is not the exact support reference
protocol.estimator: arithmetic mean of paired seed mean-flow ratios; development descriptions, no confirmation intervals
protocol.stopping_rule: all 108 cases once, one catalogue-derived gate; no threshold fitting or roster changes after results

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

certificates.arrival_model: independent Poisson job arrivals in physical time
certificates.drift_bound: E[Delta V | Q] <= B + tau_max*C - tau_min*effective_slack*sum(Q)
certificates.capacity_basis: lanes times convex hull of all admitted lane requirements/max(1,duration)

limitations: The gate certifies an unavoidable residual queue, not a flow improvement; inactive queues may also require multiple frames.
The active terminal value retains the frozen fluid approximation and stationary arrival rates during drain.
These are reused development seeds; the previously confirmed always-lookahead high-load result does not confirm the gated policy.
Wall times are descriptive measurements under three-worker execution, not dedicated latency benchmarks.
